title: Strong AI rests on a hidden dualism

statements.text: Strong AI makes sense only on the assumption that, where the mind is concerned, the brain does not matter. Programs are independent of what realizes them, so treating the mind as a program separates mind from brain, a dualism that is not Cartesian about substances but Cartesian in cutting the mental off from the brain.
